versions.changelog:
- Added IMAP as the primary and universal email integration method for document scanning.
- Updated setup instructions for secure configuration and clarified support for all IMAP-compatible providers; OAuth via Gmail API and Microsoft Graph API now optional.
- SMTP, calendar, and Slack integrations are now optional and require environment variables if desired.
- All auto-responses now explicitly require human approval.
- Metadata expanded to reflect new environment variable requirements and all supported optional integrations.
- Documentation and description streamlined for clarity and easier onboarding.

Initial release of Greek Email Processor.  
- Automatically detects and classifies Greek financial documents, AADE notifications, bank statements, invoices, receipts, and client emails across Gmail, Outlook, and other providers.
- Native Greek language processing, including document type, date, currency, address, and VAT number recognition.
- Real-time monitoring with multi-account support and configurable label/folder rules.
- Intelligent document extraction, smart forwarding, and automated Greek-language client notifications.
- Priority-based workflows for urgent communications, tax deadlines, and payment requests.
- Integrated with Google Workspace, Microsoft Outlook, Yahoo, and custom IMAP/POP3 accounts for Greek accounting automation.
